data.name: Claretta
data.gender_notes: Claretta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'clarus', meaning 'clear, bright, shining'. The name Claretta was popular among the early Christians and was given to babies born during the Christmas season, symbolizing the light of Christ. The name Claretta carries the meaning “Clear, bright, shining” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Claretta usually hope their child will grow to embody clear, bright, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of clarity, enlightenment, and the light of God.
data.etymology: Claretta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Clear, bright, shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Claretta total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

This name signifies the light and the brightness of newly born children, reflecting the arrival of the Light of the World, Jesus Christ, into the world.
data.spiritual_significance: Claretta is a name that carries a deep spiritual meaning in the Christian tradition. It reminding us of the promise of light and salvation that comes with the birth of Jesus Christ. The name identifies the bearer as a child of the light, called to shine and illuminate the world around them with the love and grace of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Claretta: Clarified light. A name reflecting the inner illumination and enlightenment received through a deep and unwavering faith in God.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Claretta was a noblewoman in the court of King Henry II of England in the 12th century. The name Claretta carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Claretta remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Mary Claretta, a minister in Athens, Greece, shares that their name Claretta meaning "Clear, bright, shining" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
